'''King's Lancer''' is an [[inn]] in [[Sienda]] in [[Amadicia]]. One of the boar horses with [[Valan Luca]]'s menagerie took offense at the inn sign and tore down the sign and damaged the inn. Some of the guests had to leave after the damage.{{ref/book|5|13}}
